newsitem.title: USA: Louisville feeder cattle steady-up $4 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Louisville feeder cattle steady-up $4 - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers under 500 lbs were $3.00 to $4.00 per cwt higher; over 500 lbs steady, USDA said. Feeder heifers were steady.
Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 62.00-69.00; 700-800 lbs 62.00-66.50; 800-900 lbs 61.00-66.00. Medium and Large 2 500- 600 lbs 58.50-65.50. Holsteins - Large 2 600-700 lbs few 47.00.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 55.00-60.00; 700-800 lbs 58.00-61.00. Medium and Large 2 600-700 lbs 52.50-55.00. Cattle and Calves Receipts - 3,450
